empreintes.intro: In the mud of a path or by a stream, tracks tell you who passes your camp at night. Here are the ones from our forests, not American ones.
etapes: Wild boar: two large hoof toes, and two small marks (dewclaws) clearly visible behind. Often with the ground rooted up all around.
Roe deer: two slender, pointed toes in a heart shape, 4 to 5 cm. The dewclaws almost never show.
Red deer: like the roe deer but bigger and rounder, 7 to 9 cm.
Fox: four toes and a pad, in a narrow oval, with claws. The front toes stand apart: you can draw a cross between the pads. The trail runs in a straight line.
Dog: like the fox but rounder, toes more spread. The trail zigzags.
Wolf: like a big dog (over 10 cm), longer, in a straight line over long distances.
Badger: five toes in a row in front of a broad pad, with long claws. Like a small bear's paw.
Pine marten and beech marten: five small toes around a pad, prints often grouped in pairs (moving in bounds).
Hare: the two big hind feet land in front of the two small forefeet: the trail forms a Y.
Beaver and otter, by the water: five webbed toes. Large 15 cm hind foot for the beaver, round 6 cm print for the otter.
attention: Wolf: it avoids humans. Store your food properly, and report a sighting to the wolf network in your country (Réseau Loup in Wallonia).
Wild boar: never get between a sow and her piglets.
empreintes.source: Standard bivouac and survival know-how, written for Bivaska

doigts_soleil.intro: Without a watch, your fingers are enough to tell how much time is left before dark, and so whether to set up camp now.
etapes: Stretch your arm out in front of you, hand flat and horizontal, fingers together, little finger resting on the horizon.
Count how many fingers fit between the horizon and the bottom of the sun. Stack your other hand above if needed.
Count about 15 minutes per finger, roughly an hour per hand.
In Belgium and further north, the sun goes down at a slant: count rather 10 to 15 minutes per finger, especially in autumn and winter.
Keep a margin: it gets dark in the forest well before official sunset. Put up your shelter with at least an hour of daylight left.
attention: Never look straight at the sun: aim just below it, or through the trees.
doigts_soleil.source: Standard bivouac and survival know-how, written for Bivaska

rj_brochette_champi.intro: The very first dish you cook when setting out on an adventure: mushrooms threaded on a branch and browned over the embers.
etapes: Cut a green hazel branch, bark removed at the end, and carve a point. Green wood doesn't burn.
Thread the whole mushrooms on by the stem, packed tightly so they don't spin.
Brush with oil or butter, add salt and the thyme.
Hold the skewer 10 cm above the embers, not in the flames, turning often: 6 to 8 minutes.
It's ready when they're golden and release a little juice.
attention: Shop-bought mushrooms only. Never cook a wild mushroom unless you're absolutely sure: some are deadly.

recette.jeu: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
ingredients: 250 g of button mushrooms or oyster mushrooms
A knob of butter or a drizzle of oil

rj_brochette_champi.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_brochette_viande.intro: Pieces of meat and vegetables seared on a branch. The meal that gets you back on your feet after a long walk.
etapes: At home: marinate the meat with the oil and herbs in a sealed box, kept cool.
At camp: thread meat, pepper and onion alternately onto a green branch carved to a point.
Cook over glowing red embers, 10 cm above, turning a quarter turn every 2 minutes.
Beef: 8 to 10 minutes. Chicken: 12 to 15 minutes, until cooked through.
Salt at the end, not before, so the meat stays tender.
attention: Poultry and pork must be cooked through: cut the biggest piece, the flesh must no longer be pink and the juices must run clear.
Raw meat doesn't keep more than half a day out of the fridge: cook it on the first evening.

recette.jeu: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
ingredients: 300 g of beef or chicken in 3 cm cubes

rj_brochette_viande.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_pomme_miel.intro: A melting apple that caramelises gently in the embers. The simplest bivouac dessert.
etapes: Remove the apple's core with the tip of the knife, without piercing the bottom.
Fill the hole with honey, cinnamon and butter.
Wrap the apple in two layers of foil, the top well closed.
Put it in a hollow of hot ashes at the edge of the fire, not on glowing embers, and cover with ash: 20 to 25 minutes. It candies in its own juice.
It's ready when the tip of the knife goes in without resistance. Open carefully: the honey is scalding.
attention: Take the foil home with you: it doesn't burn and doesn't break down.

recette.jeu: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and RPG healing potions

rj_pomme_miel.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and RPG healing potions. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_ragout_champi.intro: A thick soup served in the mess tin, which warms you up in one go.
etapes: Slice the onion and mushrooms on a board or the mess-tin lid.
Melt the butter in the mess tin over the flame, then soften the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and garlic, and cook for 5 minutes until they release their water.
Pour in 40 cl of water and the stock cube. Let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Off the heat, add the instant mash flakes to thicken and stir.
attention: Shop-bought mushrooms only. Never cook a wild mushroom unless you're absolutely sure: some are deadly.
rj_ragout_champi.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Minecraft. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_patate_braise.intro: A potato put in the fire, opened steaming with a little butter.
etapes: Wash the potato and prick it several times with the knife.
Wrap it in two layers of foil.
Make a space in the embers, put it in and cover it with embers.
Leave it 40 to 50 minutes, turning it once.
Test with the tip of the knife: it should go into the centre without forcing. Cut a cross on top, add butter, salt and cheese.
attention: Take it out with a stick or tongs: the foil stays scalding for a long time.
rj_patate_braise.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Minecraft. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_ragout_lapin.intro: The big dish that simmers while you set up camp.
etapes: Brown the legs in the oil at the bottom of the pot, 5 minutes on each side.
Add the sliced onion, then the carrots and potatoes in chunks.
Cover with water, add the stock cube, thyme and bay leaf.
Hang the pot from the pot hanger over small flames, and let it simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour, lid on.
The meat should come off the bone by itself.
attention: Poultry and pork must be cooked through: cut the biggest piece, the flesh must no longer be pink and the juices must run clear.
Don't hunt: buy the rabbit. Hunting requires a licence and is tightly regulated.
rj_ragout_lapin.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Minecraft. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_poisson_baton.intro: A whole trout planted in front of the fire, the skin crispy.
etapes: Salt the inside and slip the thyme and a slice of lemon into the belly.
Thread the fish onto a green branch, from mouth to tail, running along the backbone.
Plant the branch in the ground, leaning towards the embers, 20 to 30 cm from the heat: the fish cooks by radiant heat, never in the flames.
Turn it after 8 to 10 minutes. Allow 15 to 20 minutes in all.
It's cooked when the flesh is white and opaque and comes away from the bone.
attention: See the sheet “Preparing and cooking a fish” to gut it properly.

recette.jeu: Minecraft, Far Cry and Red Dead Redemption 2
ingredients: 1 gutted trout per person (shop-bought, or caught with a licence)

rj_poisson_baton.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Minecraft, Far Cry and Red Dead Redemption 2. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_steak_broche.intro: A big piece of meat turned on a spit over the fire. The whole art is stopping at the right moment.
etapes: Plant two Y-shaped sticks on either side of the fire, 30 cm from the embers.
Push a straight green branch lengthwise through the meat, and rest it on the two Ys.
Brush with oil. Turn a quarter turn every 2 minutes.
Rare: 12 to 15 minutes. Medium: 18 to 20 minutes. Press the centre: springy means rare; firm means well done.
Let it rest 5 minutes on a clean stone before cutting, then salt it.
attention: Embers, not flames: a lively flame burns the outside and leaves the centre raw.

ingredients: A thick piece of beef (flank or sirloin, 3 to 4 cm)

rj_steak_broche.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Monster Hunter. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_ragout_camp.intro: The camp's big pot, to which everyone adds what they have. Meat, vegetables, and more water as long as there are people.
etapes: Sear the meat in a little fat at the bottom of the pot, over a lively flame.
Add the onion, then the vegetables in big chunks and the paprika.
Cover with water, add the stock cube and thyme, and let it simmer on the pot hanger for 1 h 30, over a low fire.
Add the drained beans 10 minutes before the end.
Taste, adjust the salt, and serve with trapper's bread.
attention: Poultry and pork must be cooked through: cut the biggest piece, the flesh must no longer be pink and the juices must run clear.

ingredients: 400 g of stewing meat in cubes (beef, or shop-bought venison)

rj_ragout_camp.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_viande_herbes.titre: Meat grilled with thyme and oregano
rj_viande_herbes.intro: A slice of meat grilled on a hot stone, lifted with herbs.
etapes: Heat a flat, dry stone at the edge of the fire for 20 minutes. Take it from outside the riverbed, see the warning.
Rub the meat with the herbs, salt and pepper.
Lay it on the scorching stone: it should sizzle straight away.
Turn it after 4 to 5 minutes, and allow the same on the other side. Longer for pork, which must be cooked through.
Let it rest 2 minutes before eating.
attention: Never use a stone taken from water or very damp: the water trapped inside can make it burst in the fire.
Poultry and pork must be cooked through: cut the biggest piece, the flesh must no longer be pink and the juices must run clear.

ingredients: Pork chops or slices of beef
Dried thyme and oregano (or fresh wild thyme, if you recognise it with certainty)

rj_viande_herbes.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_pommes_chou.intro: A sweet-and-sour winter stew, very Nordic, that fills you up and warms you.
etapes: Melt the butter in the pot and brown the sliced onion.
Add the cabbage in thin strips and stir for 5 minutes until it shrinks.
Add the apples in quarters and the sausages in slices.
Pour in 30 cl of water with the stock cube, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes over a low fire.
The cabbage should be meltingly soft and the apples half fallen apart.
rj_pommes_chou.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_roule_cannelle.intro: Dough rolled in a spiral around a stick, browned over the fire then rolled in cinnamon sugar. The evening treat.
etapes: At camp, gradually add about 12 cl of water, or milk, and knead until you get a soft dough that no longer sticks.
Roll finger-thick sausages, 30 cm long.
Wind each sausage in a spiral around a peeled green branch as thick as your thumb.
Cook over the embers, turning constantly, 10 to 12 minutes, until golden and it sounds hollow.
Remove from the stick, roll in the cinnamon sugar, then drizzle with icing sugar mixed with a few drops of water to make a glaze.
attention: See also the sheet “Trapper's bread (bannock)”: same dough, savoury version.
rj_roule_cannelle.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_soupe_carotte.intro: A sweet orange soup, easy and filling.
etapes: Cut everything into small dice so it cooks quickly.
Soften the onion in the butter, then add carrots, potato and cumin.
Just cover with water with the stock cube, and boil gently for 20 to 25 minutes.
Mash the vegetables with a fork or the bottom of a mug, directly in the mess tin.
Add water if it's too thick.
rj_soupe_carotte.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Valheim. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_saucisses.intro: Sausages grilled on the end of a stick: the absolute campfire classic.
etapes: Carve a green branch to a point for each person.
Spear the sausage lengthwise.
Hold it above the embers, not in the flames, and turn often so it cooks evenly.
Smoked sausage: 5 minutes. Fresh sausage: 12 to 15 minutes, it must be cooked through.
Slip it into the bread with mustard.
attention: Don't prick the skin too much: dripping fat sets the embers alight and blackens the sausage.
Poultry and pork must be cooked through: cut the biggest piece, the flesh must no longer be pink and the juices must run clear.
rj_saucisses.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Valheim. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_iguane_baton.intro: The desert snack, Ardennes version: long strips of spiced chicken grilled on a stick. No iguana, promise.
etapes: Cut the chicken into long, thin strips, lengthwise.
Rub with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt.
Thread each strip concertina-style, zigzagging, onto a green branch.
Grill over the embers 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Squeeze lime over it before eating.
attention: Poultry and pork must be cooked through: cut the biggest piece, the flesh must no longer be pink and the juices must run clear.
rj_iguane_baton.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by Fallout: New Vegas. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_potion_soin.titre: Healing potion: nettle and honey tea
rj_potion_soin.intro: The games' red potion, forest version: a hot tea of nettle, honey and lemon. It doesn't heal wounds, but it warms you up and lifts your spirits.
etapes: Pick with a glove or a folded burdock leaf, away from paths, treated fields and places where dogs go.
Rinse the leaves in drinking water.
Boil 50 cl of water, take it off the heat and add the nettles.
Let it steep for 8 minutes, lid on, then strain.
Add the honey and lemon juice. The tea loses its sting while steeping.
attention: Only drink plants identified with certainty: several poisonous plants grow in the same places.
It's not a medicine: a real injury is treated with the “First aid” sheets.

ingredients: A handful of young nettle leaves (the tops of the stems)

rj_potion_soin.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by role-playing game healing potions. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned

rj_papillote_vigor.intro: Protein, salt for the effort, fat from the butter.
etapes: The shield: spread out a large sheet of aluminium foil, doubled if it's thin.
The assembly: put the meat and mushrooms in the centre. Add the garlic, salt, pepper, and the butter on top.
The seal: fold the foil into an airtight parcel, the juice mustn't leak.
The fire: clear a bed of hot embers without flames, and put the parcel straight on it.
The timer: 15 to 20 minutes, turning once halfway with two sticks. Open carefully: the steam burns.
attention: Shop-bought mushrooms only. Never cook a wild mushroom unless you're absolutely sure: some are deadly.
With bacon, it must be well cooked and grilled, not just warm.

recette.jeu: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
ingredients: 1 beef steak (or thick bacon) in large dice
1 small knob of butter (or a drizzle of oil)

rj_papillote_vigor.source: Original Bivaska recipe, inspired by The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. Unofficial: Bivaska is not affiliated with or endorsed by any publisher of the games mentioned
